en: The postcard features a historic black-and-white (or sepia-toned) photograph of a grand, ornate street scene with impressive late-19th-century European-style buildings. The street is bustling with people and horse-drawn vehicles. The top of the front image reads 'Sundsvall. Storgatan,' indicating a scene from Sundsvall's main street. The reverse side has 'BREVKORT' and 'CARTE POSTALE' printed, with sections for messages and addresses, and credits to 'Gottfrid Österman, Sundsvall.'
